request.prompt: From this photo of an ornate 1890s Gründerzeit building facade, extract the carved stone cartouche ornament seen on the underside of the curved corner balcony (top right of the photo): a baroque shell-and-scroll cartouche with acanthus leaves. Show that single ornament as an isolated relief object, front view, cream-white painted sandstone with light weathering, on a flat thin backing plate. Whole object visible, centred, plain light grey studio background, soft even lighting, no building, no text.

derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

rights: Image and mesh stages ran on the owner's paid Meshy account; the inputs were the owner's own photographs. The fountain statues and canopy reproduce a 15th-century public monument and the ornaments an 1890s facade; their original designs are long out of copyright, and no photograph is distributed. Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-18. These models also appear inside the owner's GRANDWHIS world packs.
